losers.headline: Why is crypto market maker Wintermute making a major push into traditional markets with plans to deploy $1 billion? Scott Melker breaks down what’s behind the move and why Wintermute is expanding beyond crypto. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
